one_liner.zh: 空城计模式会安排多轮思考与占位工具调用。
one_liner.en: A preset mode schedules multiple reasoning rounds and placeholder tool calls.

local: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with preset support; copy the preset directory into the user presets folder.

install.command: pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:HuaJi2077/empty-fort-strategy

config_items.name: thinkingRounds
config_items.description: Thinking rounds; raised as needed to end after the configured tool calls.

config_items.name: toolCalls
config_items.description: Number of placeholder tool calls, minimum 1.

config_items.name: outputFinal
config_items.description: When false, finish with a blank line; when true, allow a normal final answer.

completeness.reason: Preset implements configurable rounds, tool registration, and turn-end handling with defaults and bounds.
